member.name: F:DotNetCore.HayateOP.Metrics.HayateDiagnostics._cachedEventNames
member.summary: Cache of per-pool event names. Event names depend only on poolName (immutable at runtime), avoiding a new interpolated string allocation before every DiagnosticSource.Write(string, object) call. A diagnostics instance is normally one per pool; when several pools share the same instance the reference comparison fails and falls back to rebuilding, with unchanged semantics. volatile ensures the rebuilt is safely published (the field is made coherently visible as a whole).
